caption: The drawing displays a fashion design with three main objects set against an off-white background. The largest object is a long, red garment, likely a dress or robe, which features elaborate gold or black embroidery along the edges and runs down to a wide, trailing hem on the floor; this garment is shown from the back. The upper portion of the dress has short white sleeves with black detailing at the edges and is gathered at the back with a red rectangular bow at the waist. Above and slightly left of the main dress is a smaller sketch showing the bodice details, including a white top with short, puffed sleeves and decorative dots or small embroidery along the neckline and sleeve seams, with a thin red band below the bust. Below the bodice sketch and to the left of the red garment's train is a decorative paisley pattern in red filled with intricate black designs, likely a detail of embroidery intended for the dress. The composition is arranged so that the main red dress occupies most of the right and lower portions of the image, while the supplementary garment sketches and motif are in the upper left and center left, respectively.
title: Court Train
